issues.detail: The Greek 'αὐτῷ' (autō) is a dative pronoun meaning 'to Him' or 'unto Him'. The Vietnamese translation 'Nguyền Ngài' uses 'Nguyền' which means 'to curse' or 'to vow/swear', completely misinterpreting the grammatical function of the pronoun as a verb.

The Greek 'εἰς πᾶσας τὰς γενεὰς' (eis pasas tas geneas) means 'to all generations'. The Vietnamese 'trải qua mọi dòng dõi' (through/across all lineages) changes the direction of the action from 'to' to 'through'.
